attempts.surface: Visible conversation and Trace tabs via CDP 9234; existing tpt-workspace project

actual_preconditions.action: one read-only tool call on round-owned DIALOG030 fixture

attempts.input: Single read-only file operation from DIALOG-046-A01; then inspect conversation and Trace surfaces for action summary and expandable detail controls.
actual_steps: Observed the completed one-read task in the conversation tab.
Observed that the conversation displayed only final reply READ_LOGS_OK and task statistics; no per-action summary appeared in that conversation view.
Opened Trace tab; it showed the full read call and content.
Inspected visible expanded controls; no individual tool-action summary with a dedicated expand control was identified.
attempts.wait_condition: Inspected after the single read task reached terminal state.

checkpoints.observed: Conversation view showed final reply and task statistics only; no single-action summary appeared there. It is unclear whether the case expects a separate activity-summary surface.
Switching to Trace exposed full details, but no per-action expandable summary control was found. The Trace tab is a navigation switch rather than a verified expand control.

attempts.observed_result: A single read action was traceable in the full Trace tab; conversation view showed only final response and statistics. No per-action collapsible summary control was identified in inspected surfaces, so the expected interaction remains uncertain.
attempts.notes: Inspection scope limited to the conversation and Trace tabs for one read task; do not equate the Trace tab with a per-action expand control or infer a defect.

product_observations.observation: Conversation displayed only the final reply; Trace tab exposed full read details. No per-action expand control was identified in those surfaces.
